blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Existing sequential recommenders usually allocate a fixed computational budget to every item in a user's interaction history, regardless of the item's contribution to the final prediction. We challenge this de facto design with two diagnostic findings. (1) Non-uniform computational need: items within the same sequence vary drastically in how much computation they require. Most converge after shallow processing while a critical minority only stabilizes at full depth. (2) Suboptimality of fixed allocation: given oracle access to the target item, a non-uniform depth assignment consistently outranks the fixed one, indicating that existing uniform computation both wastes capacity on already-converged items and sacrifices overall recommendation quality. These observations motivate a shift from fixed-depth computation to item-level adaptive reasoning. To this end, we propose LoopRec. LoopRec recursively applies a single weight-shared block and introduces a lightweight gate at each recursion boundary that makes a binary exit-or-continue decision for every item independently. Items whose representations have sufficiently matured exit early, while those requiring deeper reasoning continue to subsequent recursions. This design converts the fixed global depth into a learned, per-item property without auxiliary depth labels, and is readily adaptable to diverse backbone architectures. Extensive experiments on public benchmarks with four backbone families demonstrate that LoopRec consistently outperforms matched fixed-depth counterparts. Further analysis reveals that LoopRec's learned allocation exhibits interpretable patterns aligned with our post-hoc oracle analysis: lower-frequency items and more recent interactions naturally receive deeper computation. Our code is available at https://github.com/Elpmis117/LoopRec.
blocks.zh: 已存在的相继推荐者通常会为用户互动历史中的每一个项目分配固定的计算预算,而不管项目对最终预测的贡献如何. 我们用两个诊断结论对这一事实上的设计提出质疑。 (1) 非统一计算需要:同一序列内的项目在需要多少计算时差异很大。 多数在浅加工后趋同,而极少数只稳定在充分深度。 (2) 固定分配的不理想性:如果有甲骨文进入目标项目,非统一深度分配总是比固定的要高,表明现有统一计算已核实项目的废物容量和牺牲总体建议质量。 这些意见促使人们从固定的深度计算转向项目一级的适应性推理。 为此,我们提出"循环". Looprec 递归性地应用了单一的权重共享块,并在每个递归边界上引入一个轻量级门,使每个项独立地作出二进制出或相继决定. 其陈述已经足够成熟的项目提前退出,而需要更深入推理的项目随后继续出现。 这种设计将固定的全局深度转换为没有辅助深度标签的有学问的每件属性,并易于适应多种骨干架构. 对四个骨干家庭的公共基准进行的广泛试验表明,LoopRec的业绩一贯高于固定的、深入的对应方。 进一步的分析显示,Looperc的所学分配显示可解释的规律与我们的后预言分析一致:低频项目和更近期的相互作用自然会得到更深入的计算. 我们的代码可在https://github.com/Elpmis117/Looperc.

blocks.en: 1. Introduction
blocks.zh: 一、导 言 导言

blocks.en: Sequential recommendation models temporal patterns in user interaction histories to predict the next item of interest, supporting personalized ranking on e-commerce and online content platforms ( Kang and McAuley, 2018 ; Sun et al., 2019 ; Shin et al., 2024 ) . The dominant paradigm processes a user’s interaction history through a fixed number of stacked layers, producing item representations that are then scored against candidates for next-item prediction. This paradigm has driven steady progress over the years, from attention-based models ( Kang and McAuley, 2018 ; Sun et al., 2019 ; Hou et al., 2022 ) to architectures incorporating frequency-domain inductive biases ( Shin et al., 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2022 ; Du et al., 2023 ) and linear recurrences ( Yue et al., 2024 ; Liu et al., 2024 ; Yang et al., 2026 ) . Despite their architectural diversity, these methods share a common and largely unquestioned design choice: every item in the history receives exactly the same computational depth .
blocks.zh: 序列式推荐在用户互动史上模拟时间模式,预测下一个感兴趣的项目,支持电子商务和在线内容平台的个性化排名(Kang和McAuley,2018年;Sun等人,2019年;Shin等人,2024年). 主导范式通过固定数量的堆叠层处理一个用户的交互历史,生成项目表达,然后对下一个项目预测的候选人进行评分。 这一范式推动多年来稳步进步,从关注模式(姜和麦考利,2018年;孙等人,2019年;侯等人,2022年)到包含频率-域偏差的建筑(申等人,2024年;张等人,2022年;杜等人,2023年)和线性复发(岳等人,2024年;刘等人,2024年;杨等人,2026年). 尽管这些方法具有建筑多样性,但它们都有一个共同的、基本上没有疑问的设计选择:历史上的每一个项目都得到完全相同的计算深度。

blocks.en: We argue that this uniform allocation mismatches the nature of user behavior. A real-world interaction history is inherently heterogeneous ( Zhang et al., 2024 ; Rang et al., 2023 ) : it mixes routine repeat purchases that carry minimal predictive signal with rare, exploratory, or pivotal interactions that critically shape the user’s evolving intent. Intuitively, these items should not demand the same amount of reasoning, yet current models are structurally incapable of differentiating between them, leading to suboptimal performance.
blocks.zh: 我们主张,这种统一的分配不匹配用户行为的性质. 一个真实世界的互动历史本质上是千差万别的(Zhang等人,2024年;Rang等人,2023年 ) : 它把例行的重复采购与罕见的、探索性的或关键的互动混合在一起,这些互动对用户不断演变的意图产生了重要影响。 直觉上,这些项目不应要求同样数量的推理,但目前的模型在结构上无法区分它们,导致性能不理想.

blocks.en: To move beyond intuition, we design two diagnostic experiments on a trained three-layer SASRec model (Section 2 ). First, we find that 76.14 % 76.14\% of items already stabilize their contribution to the recommendation after a single layer, while 6.72 % 6.72\% remain sensitive through all three layers, and these two extremes frequently coexist within the same sequence. Second, a restricted oracle equipped with ground-truth target information finds the original fixed-depth allocation optimal in only 4.6 % 4.6\% of sequences, achieving up to 8.8 % 8.8\% relative Hit Rate improvement through flexible reassignment. These findings show that: uniform depth both wastes capacity on items that have already converged and under-serves the critical minority that benefits from deeper computation . This motivates us to reframe sequential recommendation as a per-item computation allocation problem.
blocks.zh: 为了超越直觉,我们设计了两个诊断实验,一个经过训练的三层SASRec模型(第2节). 第一,我们发现,76.14%的76.14\%在单层之后已经稳定了对建议的贡献,而6.72%的6.72\%通过所有三层保持敏感,这两个极端经常在同一序列内共存. 其次,一个装有地面真实目标信息的限制性甲骨文发现,最初的固定深度分配在只有4.6%的4.6%的序列中是最佳的,通过灵活调任实现了最高8.8%的8.8%的相对点击率改善。 这些调查结果表明:对于已经汇合在一起的项目,废物处理能力一致,而对于从更深入的计算中受益的关键少数,废物处理能力则不足。 这促使我们将顺序建议重新确定为每个项目计算分配问题。

blocks.en: Realizing per-item adaptive computation in sequential recommendation, however, introduces two intertwined challenges. (1) Representation alignment across depths: since different items may exit at different depths, their output representations still need to reside in a shared feature space for downstream computation and scoring. Allowing depth to vary without careful architectural design can lead to misaligned representations that are incomparable at prediction time. (2) Progressive depth determination: how much computation each item needs cannot rely on a single upfront decision, because an item’s readiness only becomes apparent as it progressively absorbs context from surrounding items. Premature commitment risks either wasting computation on already-converged items or prematurely halting those that have not yet formed a reliable representation.
blocks.zh: 然而,在顺序建议中实现每个项目的适应性计算带来了两个相互交织的挑战。 (1) 跨深度的表示一致:由于不同的项目可能在不同深度退出,其产出表示仍然需要居住在一个共用的特征空间,用于下游计算和评分. 允许深度变化而不仔细的建筑设计,可能导致在预测时间无法比拟的表达方式错位. (2) 渐进深度确定:每个项目需要多少计算不能依赖一个预先的决定,因为当一个项目逐渐吸收周围项目的背景时,其准备状态才变得明显。 过早的承诺有可能会浪费已经合并的项目的计算,或者过早地阻止那些尚未形成可靠代表性的项目。

blocks.en:
We propose LoopRec , a framework for sequential recommendation with item-level adaptive recursion. For representation alignment , LoopRec uses a recursive architecture ( Dehghani et al., 2019 ; Zhu et al., 2025 ; Tang et al., 2026 ; Bae et al., 2026 ) ,
reusing a single weight-shared block across all depths. Since every recursion maps through the same parameters, items exiting at any depth naturally produce representations in the same feature space. For progressive depth determination , LoopRec places a lightweight binary gate at each recursion boundary that evaluates each item’s current state after absorbing the latest round of context, and decides whether it is ready to exit or should proceed to the next recursion. Items exit progressively as they converge, while those that benefit from deeper reasoning remain active. This design requires no auxiliary depth labels, introduces minimal additional parameters, and is readily adaptable to diverse backbone architectures.
blocks.zh:
我们提议循环建议(Looprocco),作为项目级适应性重复的顺序建议框架。 在表示一致方面,Looperc采用递归结构(Dehghani等人,2019年;Zhu等人,2025年;Tang等人,2026年;Bae等人,2026年),
重新使用一个横跨所有深度的单一重量共享区块。 由于每一个通过相同参数的重复图,在任何深度退出的项目自然会在同一特征空间产生表示. 为了进行渐进深度测定,Looprec在每个递归边界上放置一个轻量级二进制门,在吸收最近一轮上下文后评价每个项目的当前状态,并决定它是否准备退出,还是应该进入下一次递归。 项目随着趋同而逐步退出,而从更深入的推理中受益的项目仍然活跃。 这种设计不需要辅助深度标签,引入了最低限度的额外参数,并且很容易适应多种骨干架构.

blocks.en: We conduct extensive experiments on three public benchmarks with four different backbone families. LoopRec consistently outperforms the matched fixed-depth counterpart. Beyond accuracy gains, in-depth analysis of the learned routing reveals interpretable allocation patterns aligned with our post-hoc oracle analysis: the model naturally devotes deeper computation to lower-frequency items and more recent interactions, precisely the groups that an oracle would also allocate more computation to.
blocks.zh: 我们与四个不同的骨干家庭就三个公共基准进行了广泛的试验。 LoopRec 一直比对应的固定深度对应器要好 。 除了准确性提高之外,对所学到的路径的深入分析揭示了与我们的后预言分析相一致的可解释的分配模式:该模型自然将更深的计算用在更低频项目和最近的互动上,确切地说,是预言者也会将更多的计算分配给哪些组.

blocks.en: Our contributions are summarized as follows: • We use two complementary diagnostics to reveal variation in item-level computational demand and the limitations of fixed-depth processing in sequential recommendation. • We propose LoopRec, which combines a shared recursive backbone with learned item-level stopping decisions to adapt computation depth within each interaction history. • Experiments on three datasets and four backbones show consistent ranking improvements, with routing analyses revealing deeper computation for less frequent and more recent items.
blocks.zh: • 我们的贡献概述如下: 我们利用两个互补的诊断方法来揭示项目一级计算需求的差异和按顺序建议的固定深度处理的局限性。 我们提议LoopRec,它结合一个共享的递归主干线和学到的项级停止决定,以适应每个相互作用历史中的计算深度. • 三个数据集和四个主干线的试验显示,排名不断提高,路线分析显示,对较不频繁和较新的项目进行更深入的计算。

blocks.en: 2. Diagnostic Analysis
blocks.zh: 2. 诊断分析

blocks.en: Before presenting LoopRec, we empirically probe the uniform-depth assumption with two diagnostic experiments on Amazon Office Products ( Hou et al., 2024 ) using a three-layer SASRec ( Kang and McAuley, 2018 ) . We investigate: • RQ1: How is computational demand distributed across items within the same sequence under fixed-depth processing? • RQ2: To what extent does the fixed-depth allocation affect recommendation quality relative to flexible per-item alternatives?

blocks.en: Finding 1: Non-uniform computational demand. Items within the same sequence exhibit highly heterogeneous computational demands. Most items converge after minimal processing, while a non-trivial minority requires full depth. Since both groups frequently coexist within the same sequence, no single fixed depth can simultaneously serve all items well.

blocks.en: 2.2. Probe 2: Item-Level Depth Allocation
blocks.zh: 2.2. 探测2:项目深度分配

blocks.en: Probe 1 establishes that items differ in how much computation they need, but does not tell us whether this mismatch actually hurts recommendation quality. To bridge this gap, we design a controlled experiment: keeping model parameters frozen, we ask whether a per-item flexible depth assignment can produce better rankings than the original fixed allocation.
blocks.zh: 探测1确定项目在计算需要多少时不同,但没有告诉我们这种不匹配是否实际上伤害了推荐质量. 为了弥补这一差距,我们设计了一个有控制的实验:保持模型参数的冻结,我们询问每个项目的灵活深度分配是否能产生比原固定分配更好的排名.

blocks.en: Specifically, we construct a counterfactual search over the five most recent items in each test sequence. Each of these items is allowed to exit after depth 1, 2, or 3, while earlier positions retain the original full-depth pass. The original fixed-depth assignment is included as a candidate. An offline oracle with access to the ground-truth target then selects the assignment that achieves the best target rank. Construction details are in Appendix A.3 .
blocks.zh: 具体地说,我们构建了一个反事实 搜索每一个测试序列中最新的五个项目。 每件物品在深度1,2或3后允许出境,而先前的位置保留了原来的全深度通行证. 最初的固定深度任务列为候选人. 离线甲骨文可以访问地面真实目标,然后选择达到最佳目标等级的任务. 施工详情见附录A.3。

blocks.en: Finding 2: Suboptimality of fixed allocation. The fixed-depth allocation is locally suboptimal in the overwhelming majority ( 95.4 % 95.4\% ) of sequences. A flexible per-item assignment improves ranking quality while often reducing total computation, demonstrating that uniform depth actively leaves performance on the table.
blocks.zh: 查找 2: 固定分配的不优化。 固定深度分配在绝大多数序列(95.4%95.4+++)中是地方次优化分配. 灵活的逐项任务可以提高排名质量,同时经常减少总计算,表明统一深度会积极让业绩留在桌上.

blocks.en: These two findings establish a strong empirical case for treating depth as a per-item computation allocation variable in sequential recommendation, motivating the design of LoopRec.
blocks.zh: 这两项结论为将深度作为顺序建议中的每个项目计算分配变量提供了强有力的经验依据,推动了LoopRec的设计。

blocks.en: 3. The Proposed LoopRec
blocks.zh: 3个 拟议循环

blocks.en: To address the inefficiency of fixed-depth computation in sequential recommendation, we propose LoopRec, an adaptive routing framework built on a single shared backbone. LoopRec recursively reuses the same backbone block and lets a depth router assign different history positions to different recursion depths, so that computation is dynamically allocated item by item while the standard next-item prediction objective remains unchanged. Sec. 3.1 formulates the task, Sec. 3.2 presents depth-routed recursion, and Sec. 3.3 describes the training objective.
blocks.zh: 为了解决顺序建议中固定深度计算效率低下的问题,我们提议采用Looperc,即一个基于单一共享主干线的适应性路由框架。 循环循环重复使用相同的主干块,让深度路由器为不同的循环深度分配不同的历史位置,这样在标准下一个项目预测目标保持不变的同时,计算会被按项目动态分配. 第3.1条提出了任务,第3.2条提出了深度路线的重复,第3.3条说明了培训目标。

blocks.en: 3.1. Task Formulation
blocks.zh: 3.1. 任务制定

blocks.en:
We consider the standard next-item prediction task in sequential
recommendation over an item set 𝒱 \mathcal{V} . Each training instance is an interaction sequence 𝐬 = [ v 1 , … , v n ] \mathbf{s}=[v_{1},\dots,v_{n}] , where v t ∈ 𝒱 v_{t}\in\mathcal{V} and the items are ordered by interaction time.
Given the prefix 𝐬 1 : t = [ v 1 , … , v t ] \mathbf{s}_{1:t}=[v_{1},\dots,v_{t}] , the goal is to predict the next item v t + 1 v_{t+1} , where 1 ≤ t < n 1\leq t<n .

Motivated by this observation, LoopRec allocates computation depth at the item level while keeping the standard
next-item prediction objective unchanged. blocks.en: To realize this adaptive-depth mechanism within a single model, LoopRec treats the backbone block as a reusable computation unit and shares it across recursions. Let ℬ ⁡ ( ⋅ ) \mathcal{B}(\cdot) denote a shared backbone block with L L layers, and let R R be the maximum number of recursions. We denote this layer–recursion configuration as LxRy . For example, L2R3 uses a two-layer shared block for up to three recursions. Given 𝐗 \mathbf{X} , LoopRec proceeds through three components. Initial Context Encoding first applies ℬ ⁡ ( ⋅ ) \mathcal{B}(\cdot) to the full sequence to obtain contextualized states for all positions. Depth-Routed Recursion then applies adaptive depth routing at each recursion boundary: the depth router makes a stop-or-continue decision for each active position and re-applies the shared block only to positions that continue, until all positions stop or the recursion budget is reached. Finally, Depth-Specific Readout forms the representation used for next-item prediction from the state at the selected depth. A position that stops after recursion r r has effectively received r ​ L rL layers of sequential encoding. Figure 3 provides an overview.

blocks.en: 3.3. Training Objective
blocks.zh: 3.3. 培训目标

blocks.en:
The key additional component in LoopRec, compared with a fixed-depth sequential recommender, is the depth router. Training therefore needs to ensure that this router is both useful and learnable. First, it should allocate different positions to different depths. Otherwise LoopRec collapses toward nearly fixed-depth behavior and loses
the item-level adaptivity motivated in Sec. 2 . Second, it should remain trainable throughout optimization. Because routing decisions are made recursively, gates that become too hard too early can lock the model into unstable depth assignments before the hidden states are well formed. The objective design below is organized around these two requirements.
blocks.zh:
与固定的深度顺序推荐器相比,LoopRec中的关键附加组件是深度路由器. 因此,培训必须确保这种路由器既有用又可学习。 首先,它应该为不同的深度分配不同的立场。 否则Looprec崩溃,走向近乎固定的深度行为,失去
第2节中激发的项级适配性。 第二,应在整个优化过程中保持可训练性。 因为路由决定是递归性的,所以太过硬的闸门在隐藏状态形成之前可以锁定模型的不稳定深度任务. 以下客观设计是围绕这两项要求编排的.

blocks.en: Avoiding Depth Collapse. To avoid depth collapse, we regularize depth usage along the realized route. The idea is to assign each position a soft depth mass over the depths it actually visits, and then match the aggregate soft usage to the empirical hard assignment frequencies across positions. We first define the continuation mass that reaches each boundary.

blocks.en: Backbones. LoopRec is instantiated on four widely used backbone families to test its compatibility with different sequence modeling architectures: • SASRec ( Kang and McAuley, 2018 ) is a self-attention sequential recommender and serves as the main attention anchor. It gives the most direct comparison with a Transformer recommender of fixed depth. • BSARec ( Shin et al., 2024 ) is a frequency-aware self-attention variant. It adds a frequency-domain bias to the SASRec family and tests transfer within attention models. • NextItNet ( Yuan et al., 2019 ) is a causal convolutional recommender. It uses causal convolutions and represents the convolutional family. • LRURec ( Yue et al., 2024 ) is a linear recurrent recommender. Together with NextItNet, it tests whether LoopRec remains applicable beyond attention backbones.

blocks.en: 5. Related Work
blocks.zh: 5.五. 有关工作

blocks.en:
Sequential Recommendation. Sequential recommendation models an ordered interaction history to
rank the next item. Early factorized and neural approaches capture
local transition structure via Markov chains, recurrent networks, or
convolutional encoders ( Rendle et al., 2010 ; Hidasi et al., 2015 ; Tang and Wang, 2018 ; Yuan et al., 2019 ; Li et al., 2017 ; Liu et al., 2018 ) .
Transformer-based recommenders such as SASRec and BERT4Rec then
strengthen long-range dependency modeling with self
attention ( Kang and McAuley, 2018 ; Sun et al., 2019 ; Li et al., 2020 ; Zhou et al., 2020a ; Xie et al., 2022 ; Qiu et al., 2022 ) . More recent
fixed-depth backbones refine the encoder design with explicit
inductive biases, for instance through frequency-domain or filtering
mechanisms ( Shin et al., 2024 ; Zhou et al., 2022 ; Du et al., 2023 ) . These methods focus on how to build stronger sequence encoders under a fixed computation pattern
: once the architecture is chosen, each history
position is processed by the same depth budget before scoring the next
item. LoopRec addresses an orthogonal question. Keeping the
recommendation objective and backbone family intact, it asks whether
a sequential encoder can allocate recursive computation at the item level, so that different positions in the same history
need not receive the same depth.

blocks.en:
Looped and Adaptive-Depth Transformers. Looped Transformers study the repeated application of shared or
partially shared Transformer blocks.
The Universal Transformer combines shared recurrent transformations with self-attention and supports adaptive per-position halting ( Dehghani et al., 2019 ) , building on adaptive computation time ( Graves, 2016 ) . Later work shows that
looped Transformers can implement non-trivial algorithmic
computation ( Giannou et al., 2023 ; Yang et al., 2024 ) . Recent looped Transformer and
looped language-model studies connect repeated depth with latent
computation and reasoning ( Saunshi et al., 2025 ; Zhu et al., 2025 ) . In parallel,
adaptive-depth Transformers explore early exiting or routed computation
allocation ( Elbayad et al., 2020 ; Raposo et al., 2024 ; Schuster et al., 2022 ; Xin et al., 2020 ; Liu et al., 2020 ; Zhou et al., 2020b ) . Mixture-of-Recursions (MoR) combines shared recursion with token-level adaptive computation for language modeling ( Bae et al., 2026 ) . Its token-choice router assigns a total recursion depth upfront, while its expert-choice router selects continuing tokens at each step under prescribed capacities. LoopRec uses a shared binary stopping gate conditioned on each item’s current contextualized state and recursion index, allowing decisions to be updated across recursions without per-step top- k k selection. We investigate this design for computation allocation over recommendation histories, supported by item-level diagnostics and evaluation across multiple backbone families.

blocks.en: 6. Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6个 结论

blocks.en:
We revisited fixed-depth computation in sequential recommendation
through diagnostic experiments that reveal heterogeneous depth sensitivity
across history items. Motivated by these findings, we proposed LoopRec ,
which uses weight-shared recursion with learned item-wise routing to
allocate computation adaptively. Across three Amazon benchmarks and
four backbone families, LoopRec consistently improves ranking performance
over fixed-depth counterparts. Its learned routes allocate greater depth
to recent and less frequent items, consistent with the patterns observed
in these diagnostics.
LoopRec also reduces the encoder computation budget in the measured
configurations, although latency gains vary. Future work includes
developing sparsity-aware kernels and learning the maximum recursion budget,
which is currently fixed per configuration before model training begins.
